name: intervals-icu-mcp
description: Read and plan your training in Intervals.icu.
long_description: Lets Claude read your Intervals.icu activities, fitness, wellness and calendar, and plan workouts. Writes to planned workouts are limited to a safe mode by default; deletes are disabled unless you opt in.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Intervals.icu → Settings → Developer Settings → API key.

athlete_id.title: Athlete ID
athlete_id.description: Leave as 0 to use the athlete that owns the API key.

write_mode.title: Write mode
write_mode.description: read-only, safe (create and edit, no deletes) or full (deletes allowed).

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: default, all, or a comma-separated list of extra toolsets. See docs/tools.md.
